challenge.method: Compare the main description against the page's separately rendered relationship metadata, the reciprocal 1364-2005 page and the extension-era Accellera 3.1a abstract. challenge.results: The catalog prose directly supports the 2005 base and 2005 extension merger into 1800-2009. The main 1364-2005 description agrees on the forward supersession. The 1800-2009 structured label 'Superseded by 1364-2005' reverses that direction and is preserved as a catalog metadata discrepancy. The claim cites the main description rather than making a finding about every metadata field.

limitations: The proposition is about the IEEE catalog's published description of standards lineage. It does not establish exact compatibility or complete supersession metadata.
